note: The end of a battle (roadmap 18.12, M12; 17.10 and 13.45). 'par' is the number of turns a good win takes on each map, by how many fighters a side has (every fighter's turn counts as one turn). 'swiftUnder': win this many turns under par or better and the rating is Swift (3 stars, the gold banner); up to par is Steady (2 stars); over par is Long (1 star). MEASURED 14 Nov: 40 test battles at 4 against 4 ran 86 to 162 turns, middle 125, so par for 4 was 100 (the 13 Nov guess of 40 could never be met); 3 against 3 ran about 62, so par 55. MEASURED AGAIN 22 Nov after the balance pass (18.32: healthScale, weaponDamageBonus): hero wins at 4 against 4 took 55 to 107 turns, middle 72, so par for 4 is 75 (Swift at 60 or fewer, about the fastest quarter of wins); the others went down by the same share (55 to 40, 80 to 60, 45 to 35). Suleiman and Baiyee can change every number here. 'slowMs': how long the last blow plays slowly (real milliseconds), at 'slowTo' speed. 'dim': how dark the board goes behind the word.

swift.name: Swift
swift.text: Well under par: a clean, fast win.

long.name: Long
long.text: Over par: look for a faster way next time.

bonusNote: The bonus for a Swift win is the gold banner and a place in 'Best' for now; once the camp exists (Phase 15) it becomes an extra item for the next battle.
